title: Soul Feast #42: Non-Physical Teachers: Part 1
excerpt: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense?
bodyHtml:
Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn how HERE.

In this deeply personal and revealing episode, Gary Zukav opens a window into the unseen world of non-physical teachers – beings of wisdom and compassion who support our spiritual evolution beyond the limits of our five senses.

As we move from five-sensory to multisensory perception, we begin to become aware of and communicate with guidance that has always been available to us.

Previously, we have been incapable of accessing this guidance due to the limitations within a five-sensory perspective. Gary shares how his own life was transformed after his own communications with one of these teachers and invites listeners to reflect on the possibility that they too are being guided in ways they may not yet recognize.

In this Episode, Gary remembers the story of his encounter with Ambrose, a non-physical teacher who he encountered during a difficult time in his life. From a painful breakup, to a solo journey into the desert, to a transformative conversation with a channeled being in Sweden, Gary describes how this extraordinary interaction awakened him to the reality of non-physical support. This moment marked the beginning of a lifelong relationship with the unseen world – and the realization that love, guidance, and wisdom transcend form.

Ultimately, Gary reminds us that we are never alone. When we expand our awareness, we can begin to perceive and communicate with non-physical teachers, those compassionate intelligences that exist to support our journey toward love, wholeness, and authentic power.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:00) — Why every human has non-physical teachers, and how multisensory perception allows us to connect with them

(02:50) — The difference between five-sensory and multisensory awareness—and how the shift expands our understanding of time, space, and reality

(06:44) — Gary’s honest account of addiction, relationships, and the pain that opened the door to spiritual transformation

(11:05) — A mystical meeting with Ambrose: how a non-physical teacher knew what no one else could

(15:20) — What Ambrose taught Gary about keeping a “light alive” and speaking to others from the soul

(17:20) — The many ways intuition shows up – and why your unique way of connecting is exactly right for you

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Take a moment with your soul notebook and reflect: Have you ever felt a presence or received wisdom that seemed to come from beyond the physical world? Maybe it was a dream, a sudden insight, or a quiet knowing that helped you through a difficult time.

Write down these moments – what you felt, what guidance you received, and how it changed you.

Consider: Is it possible you’ve already received support from a non-physical teacher and did not realize it?
